say:1:1230718001:1.text: In the world, there are no two identical leaves, nor two identical individuals, human friends!
say:1:1230718001:1.source_cn: 世界上没有两片同样的树叶，也没有两只同样的个体，人类朋友！
say:1:1230718001:1.male: In the world, there are no two identical leaves, nor two identical individuals, human friends!
say:1:1230718001:1.female: In the world, there are no two identical leaves, nor two identical individuals, human friends!

say:2:1230718002:1.text: If you're wondering, 'Why can I say so much'...
say:2:1230718002:1.source_cn: 如果你是想问，“为什么我能说这么多”……
say:2:1230718002:1.male: If you're wondering, 'Why can I say so much'...
say:2:1230718002:1.female: If you're wondering, 'Why can I say so much'...

say:3:1230718003:1.text: Actually, everyone here is very chatty! You can talk with my friends more!
say:3:1230718003:1.source_cn: 其实大家都很健谈！你可以多找我的朋友们聊聊！
say:3:1230718003:1.male: Actually, everyone here is very chatty! You can talk with my friends more!
say:3:1230718003:1.female: Actually, everyone here is very chatty! You can talk with my friends more!
